title: Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B: local speed reports, benchmark questions
summary: Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B is a new 27B ternary-quantized model for local inference, with a reported 128k context window; the supplied item has no vendor page content, so availability and official benchmark results are not independently confirmed. The concrete performance evidence in the supplied material is anecdotal: one commenter measured about 22–25 tokens/s on a Mac Mini M5 Pro with 24 GB RAM, 222.9 tokens/s prompt processing, and 2.12 s to first token on a Python prompt, and said 128k context fit in memory. Another commenter&\#x27;s long-horizon local test reported Bonsai 2.5 passing 5 of 8 tasks in 76 minutes versus Bonsai2&\#x27;s 5 of 8 in 107 minutes. Claims that the model matches Opus 4.6 on SWE-bench Verified are community speculation and explicitly questioned, not independently verified here.
